versions.changelog:
opengis-skills v1.0.0

- Initial release of an open-source skills collection for AI programming assistants, focused on GIS, CAD, C#, AI, and IoT.
- Features an index of 56 open-source projects, each with a dedicated SKILL.md file for targeted domain knowledge injection.
- Provides tag-based search, skill indexing, and on-demand loading guides for efficient code generation and troubleshooting.
- Covers popular tools and libraries in geospatial, CAD, .NET, AI/LLM, and IoT domains.
- Includes usage scenarios and an extensive tag system for accurate skill discovery and context management.
